page.overview:
What is Yellow Rabbit?

The Yellow Rabbit is the main antagonist of Interactive Novel #2: Return to the Pit.

As Return to the Pit is an Interactive Novel, there are many possible routes and endings depending on readers' choice. The book's lore is more similar to the Fazbear Frights version than the game, as the Rabbit's attack only occurs over two days rather than five, and the original short's storyline can be followed very closely. The different routes show more of the Rabbit and clues as to how the Pit functions, reveals what happened to Chip in the future, or features the Rabbit actually capturing Oswald.

When Oswald enters the pit, but before The Missing Children Incident, there are a few new routes which feature the rabbit:

Two specific routes can be taken on the first morning where Oswald sees the Rabbit at his breakfast table. In one route, he can refuse to accept the rabbit as his father, throw pancakes at it, and then flee the house. If he goes to a neighbor for help, he finds that the neighbor was replaced by Chica who helps the Rabbit kill him. If he runs down the street, he can either be hit by the Rabbit in a car, or can join up with an adult version of Chip. Chip had heard rumors of the Yellow Rabbit, and has joined a team of vengeful adults who are prepared to finally kill the creature. When going to Chip's hideout, he meets Gabrielle, his daughter, and goes to join the final team meeting, only to find that the team's leader has been replaced by the Yellow Rabbit, and he is the only one who can see it. (Whether this means his father was the team's leader, or that the Yellow Rabbit can replace more than one person at a time, is never specified.) Attempting to call out the replacement will result in Oswald being imprisoned and killed by the Rabbit. Attempting to attack the Rabbit with Gabrielle will result in both of them being killed. If Oswald plays along and follows the group to Jeff's Pizza, the Rabbit bites off Chip's head and starts a gunfight.
